name: carbon-arc
description: Carbon Arc plugins for competitive, consumer and audience intelligence.

plugins.name: carbon-arc-company-intelligence
plugins.description: Two reports on a company. An insights report for its own strategy or analytics team: where else its customers spend, whether a move is the company or the category, which customers it is losing, what an event did, and who is winning and why. And a pre-print earnings preview of a listed consumer company's quarter, validated by a backtest against its reported history.

plugins.name: carbon-arc-talent-intelligence
plugins.description: Audience intelligence for talent management, agencies and labels: who an artist really competes with, whether their audience is growing against those peers, who the audience is, which brand partnerships are distinctively theirs, resale demand, and for actors the work itself.
